ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: tempest
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Tempests are storms given a voice. Their lightning leaps from foe to foe, their frost locks enemies in place, and their winds scatter armies.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Command lightning, ice and the wind itself. Chain-strike crowds and freeze them in place.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The sky has a temper. Tempests simply learned to aim it.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Fast chaining damage and powerful crowd control. Tempests want Potency and Celerity: low cooldowns let you weave Chain Lightning, Frost Lance and Gale Burst constantly.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: stormcaller
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Stormcallers chase the purest form of the storm. Their lightning overloads machines, bursts energy shields and tears through armies.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Pure, overwhelming lightning. Fry machines, shatter shields, call the wrath of the sky.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Your shield generators are very impressive,' said the stormcaller. Then the sky went white.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: The premier anti-mechanoid class. Overload shuts down mechs and breaks shields; Tesla Coils hold chokepoints; Wrath of the Sky ends fights. Wants Potency and Celerity.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: frostwarden
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Frostwardens are the patient side of the storm. They wall off the battlefield, freeze enemies in their tracks and shatter them.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Freeze the battlefield. Walls of ice, flash freezes and shattering blows.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: Ice remembers. It remembers the shape of everything it has ever held.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: The strongest crowd control in the game. Freeze groups with Flash Freeze, then use Shatter for triple damage. Ice Walls reshape any fight. Wants Potency and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: skybreaker
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Skybreakers master the air. They ride the wind, pelt enemies with hail, conjure tornadoes, and can even clear poisoned skies.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Wind, hail and weather. Tornadoes, hurricanes and command of the sky itself.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: When the toxic rain fell on the Wending colony, a single girl walked into the storm and told it to leave. It did.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Mobile area control and utility. Tornadoes drag enemies together, Hailstorm punishes clumps, and Clear Skies ends fallout and volcanic winters. Wants Potency and Celerity.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: conductor
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your lightning leaps to one more target per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: overcurrent
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Lightning spells leave enemies shocked and feed you mana.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: brittle
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Frost Lance fires an additional shard per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: lightning rod
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You ground electricity harmlessly. Greatly reduced damage from lightning and EMP.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: cold snap
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Frost spells occasionally freeze their target solid.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: shatterpoint
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Enemies killed by frost shatter, spraying razor ice into those around them.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: maelstrom
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Become the storm. Lightning spells hit harder, chain further, and sometimes cost nothing.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: heart of winter
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Winter follows you. Frost lasts longer, chills almost always, and enemies near you slow to a crawl.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: storm sovereign
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The sky answers you unbidden: while in combat, a free Spark strikes a random nearby enemy every second and a half.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: arc flash
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Lightning spells may blind enemies and break their energy shields.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: static shell
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: When struck, you may lash out with a free Spark at the attacker.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: storm ascendant
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your lightning ignores more armor and deals far more damage.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: living current
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your lightning has a mind of its own. Lightning hits sometimes spawn a free Chain Lightning.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: icebound
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Ice crusts your skin and dulls every blow.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: frozen tomb
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Frost spells often freeze their targets solid.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: winter knight
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Those who fight you in melee freeze; your own weapons chill.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: glaciation
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Frost spells execute weakened enemies, and Shatter becomes devastating.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: eternal winter
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You become a fortress of ice: a huge ward that regenerates rapidly, and a quarter of all damage is drained from mana instead.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: downburst
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Hailstorm drops four more stones per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: crosswind
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: A sudden gust carries you out of harm's way.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: skyfall
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Wind spells sometimes bring a free Hailstorm down on a random enemy.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: eye of god
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: See the battlefield from above. Every area spell grows enormously.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: untouchable
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Like trying to hit the wind. A quarter of all attacks simply miss as you blink away.

AbilityDef.label: spark
AbilityDef.description: A crackling bolt of lightning that arcs to a second nearby enemy.

li.flavor: Hold still. This won't hurt. Much.

AbilityDef.label: frost lance
AbilityDef.description: Fire a shard of black ice that pierces and chills.

AbilityDef.label: chain lightning
AbilityDef.description: Lightning leaps between up to five enemies, losing a little power with each jump.

AbilityDef.label: gale burst
AbilityDef.description: A violent gust explodes outward from you, hurling enemies away.

AbilityDef.label: frost armor
AbilityDef.description: Encase an ally in a lattice of enchanted ice that turns blades and soaks heat.

AbilityDef.label: rainmaker
AbilityDef.description: Seed the clouds. Rain begins to fall and nearby fires are snuffed out. Farmers will love you.

AbilityDef.label: blizzard
AbilityDef.description: Summon a howling blizzard over an area. Enemies inside take frost damage and are chilled to the bone.

AbilityDef.label: thunderstorm
AbilityDef.description: Darken the sky over an area and call down bolt after bolt of lightning.

AbilityDef.label: ball lightning
AbilityDef.description: A slow, enormous orb of plasma drifts toward the target and detonates violently.

AbilityDef.label: thunderclap
AbilityDef.description: Slam a fist of thunder into the ground, stunning and battering everyone around you.

AbilityDef.label: overload
AbilityDef.description: Flood a target with current. Shatters energy shields, shuts down mechanoids for long seconds and fries their circuits.

AbilityDef.label: tesla coil
AbilityDef.description: Conjure a crackling tesla coil that zaps enemies with chain lightning for a minute.

AbilityDef.label: wrath of the sky
AbilityDef.description: The storm takes notice. Two dozen lightning bolts annihilate a vast area while you become Stormborn.

AbilityDef.label: ice wall
AbilityDef.description: Raise a ring of enchanted ice walls around a point. Trap enemies inside or shelter friends.

AbilityDef.label: flash freeze
AbilityDef.description: Instantly freeze everything in an area solid.

AbilityDef.label: shatter
AbilityDef.description: Strike a target with a hammer of ice. Frozen targets take triple damage and the ice explodes.

AbilityDef.label: cryostasis
AbilityDef.description: Seal a badly wounded ally in protective ice. They cannot act or be harmed, and they regenerate while frozen.

AbilityDef.label: absolute zero
AbilityDef.description: All motion stops. Every enemy in a vast radius around you is frozen solid and battered by cold, and a killing blizzard rises.

AbilityDef.label: tornado
AbilityDef.description: Conjure a raging tornado that drags enemies inward and batters them for eight seconds.

AbilityDef.label: hailstorm
AbilityDef.description: Fist-sized hail rains down over an area.

AbilityDef.label: windwalk
AbilityDef.description: Ride the wind to a distant point and keep its speed for a while.

AbilityDef.label: clear skies
AbilityDef.description: Tear open the clouds. Ends toxic fallout, volcanic winter, flashstorms, cold snaps and heat waves, and calls a beautiful aurora.

AbilityDef.label: hurricane
AbilityDef.description: Unleash a hurricane. For twenty seconds a colossal vortex drags everything toward its eye and shreds it.

HediffDef.label: frost armor
HediffDef.description: A lattice of enchanted ice that turns blades and soaks heat.

ThingDef.label: tesla coil focus
ThingDef.description: The focusing crystal of a conjured construct.

ThingDef.label: tesla coil
ThingDef.description: A conjured coil crackling with lightning. It zaps nearby enemies.

ThingDef.label: ice wall
ThingDef.description: A wall of conjured ice. It will melt in time.
